extDescription.message: A Swiss-army knife for AI chatbots: Enter for newline, Ctrl+Enter to send, prompt snippets, ask other AIs and more. Works on Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini.

toolEnterNewlineDesc.message: Stops accidental sends. Cmd+Enter on macOS.

toolPaletteDesc.message: Alt+/ opens snippets and quick actions.

toolFocusDesc.message: Alt+I focuses the chat input from anywhere.

toolAskOthersDesc.message: Send the current prompt to another chatbot from the palette.

updateHelperMissing.message: The updater helper is not registered. Run updater\install-updater.bat in the extension folder once.

updatedTo.message: Updated to v$VERSION$. Refresh open chat tabs if a tool does not respond.

badgeTitleUpdate.message: AI Chat Easy — v$VERSION$ is available. Click to update.

snippetsHelp.message: Snippets appear in the command palette (Alt+/). Selecting one inserts its text at the cursor.

paletteHint.message: Type to search · Enter to run · Esc to close

defSnip1Text.message: Summarize the following in 5 bullet points, then give a one-line conclusion.

defSnip2Text.message: Explain the following so that a smart high-school student can understand it. Use one concrete example.

defSnip3Text.message: Review the code below. List bugs first, then risky parts, then readability improvements. Show fixed code only for the parts you change.

defSnip4Text.message: Translate the following. If it is Korean, translate into natural English; if it is English, translate into natural Korean.

helperGuide.message: The updater helper is not registered yet. Run updater\install-updater.bat (Windows) or updater/install-updater.sh (macOS/Linux) inside the extension folder once, then try again.
